name: Santa Margarida de Montbui (Spain)
description: Divided horizontally into three equal stripes, blue, white and blue, with a yellow triangle at the hoist whose apex reaches the centre of the white stripe.
history: The official flag of Santa Margarida de Montbui is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided horizontally into three equal stripes, blue above and below and white in the middle; the arms it accompanies were approved in the DOGC of 7 April 1989.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
